name: 45103 · Batavia, OH
findings: ZIP 45103 (Batavia) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45103 (Batavia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45103 (Batavia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
